svg.title: Zynara Health · Care Approval IQ — Technical Architecture
svg.text: H E A L T H
distinct kinds of reasoning — one pipeline

g.text: that won — and drafts this one.

svg.text: Persistent Azure AI Foundry agents behind Zynara.Core interfaces — each with a deterministic stub twin, so every test runs offline.

g.text: Durable Functions · sequences all 5 deterministic checks · keyed on request id (idempotent)
Owns every value that drives a decision — the Gate reads its output

svg.text: → each check invokes its agent (prose only)

g.text: — the only input to the system

svg.text: the region switch flips the payer rule-set & appeal path — shown live in the demo

g.text: Managed identity — SQL · Foundry · Storage, no stored secrets
Key Vault holds only App Insights + content-share strings
One App Insights trace id per request id, every hop
Every agent call metered → £/$ on the dashboard
Eval harness — scored offline, gated in CI
A human approves every outbound action
Agents never set a value, code or date — deterministic code does
No PHI in scope — request ids + procedure codes only

svg.text: Zynara Health (fictional) · Care Approval IQ · Proof beats paperwork.
